note: Frame-logic layer (2026-07-07): supplies a clarifying action beat, supporting/forbidden object lists, camera intent, and a coherence note per lane so every render is a specific believable moment, not just 'Lena in a place'. Deliberately does not restate or override a scene's own action field -- it clarifies and supports it. seated_or_table_occlusion_ok marks lanes where furniture (a table, desk, or bench) naturally occluding the lower body is expected and not a coverage violation.

default_frame_logic.frame_action: settling naturally into the moment already described by the scene, without freezing into a posed stance
frame_evidence_objects: at least one concrete prop tied to the setting
background detail consistent with the named location
frame_forbidden_objects: an empty or generic backdrop with no supporting objects
any object contradicting the named setting
default_frame_logic.camera_intent: friend-taken candid at natural eye height, never an impossible floating camera
default_frame_logic.scene_coherence_note: a specific lived-in moment, not a generic backdrop portrait

morning apartment.frame_action: pausing mid-pour by the counter, cup half-filled, weight still settling into her stance before the first sip
frame_evidence_objects: counter clutter such as a fruit bowl or mail
frame_forbidden_objects: empty counter with no mug or clutter
morning apartment.camera_intent: friend-taken candid at normal kitchen eye-height, no ring light
morning apartment.scene_coherence_note: a slow drowsy apartment start built around the coffee pour, not a staged kitchen shoot

apartment doorway.frame_action: one hand already on the doorframe, keys caught mid-swing, weight shifted toward the hallway like she is already halfway out
frame_evidence_objects: bag or tote on her shoulder
apartment light spilling from behind her
hallway just visible past the door
frame_forbidden_objects: no exit prop such as a bag or keys
outdoor street with no door in frame
apartment doorway.camera_intent: friend-taken candid from just outside the door
apartment doorway.scene_coherence_note: a confident solo exit captured at the literal threshold, not a posed hallway portrait

coffee shop.frame_action: leaning into the counter edge with the iced coffee still sweating in her hand, mid-exhale like she just sat down
frame_evidence_objects: counter clutter such as a receipt or straw wrapper
coffee shop.camera_intent: friend-taken candid from a nearby seat or counter edge
coffee shop.scene_coherence_note: an unplanned extended coffee break, grounded by the drink and counter clutter she is actually using

rainy street.frame_action: mid-stride with her coat gripped shut against the wind, glancing back like someone just called after her

rainy street.scene_coherence_note: an ordinary errand turned cinematic purely by the rain, not a studio wet-look effect

rooftop sunset.scene_coherence_note: unhurried golden-hour lingering, anchored by the skyline and railing, not a floating fashion-shoot backdrop
